items.item: Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI)
items.snippet: Changes to Section 702 include requiring monthly reviews by the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) for each U.S. person query conducted by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).

items.item: Office of the Intelligence Community Inspector General
items.snippet: ODNI must refer queries that do not comply with established standards, as well as possible abuses of civil liberties or privacy, to the Office of the Intelligence Community Inspector General.

items.item: Federal Reserve System's Board of Governors
items.snippet: The Federal Reserve System's Board of Governors may not use a CBDC to implement monetary policy or test, study, create, or implement a CBDC, with certain exceptions.
